riskTiers.meaning: Routine: offered and selected by default in the user's cleanup review; files that programs recreate or no longer need.
Review: offered but not selected in the user's cleanup review; removing them can cause reprocessing or a download.
Restricted: never offered in the user's cleanup review; only the scheduled runs act on it, as policy configures.

categories.displayName: Data of Revit versions no longer installed
